seed_namespace_note: Prelaunch draft changed from 181/182/183M and 191/192/193M to 221/222/223M and 231/232/233M because earlier compatibility checks used some original seeds. No development or candidate-quality outputs existed at this change; tiny179M retained.
hypothesis: A trainable input-gated recurrent state over actually generated units gives execution feedback an order-sensitive memory beyond fixed suffixes, improving productive generation.

candidate.residual: 0.8 * clip(dot(v,h_after_candidate), -4, 4); calibration bias omitted from categorical law
candidate.training: Full BPTT through BOS + actual generated tokens + EOS if terminated; existing 1024 generation-step limit retained.
candidate.initialization: Private Random(seed XOR 0x53455139); Wc Gaussian(0,0.16), Wz Gaussian(0,0.08), bc=0,bz=-2,v=0,bias=0.
candidate.input_mapping: Four signed 0.5 coordinates with salts1..4; unit+3+salt*0x9E3779B9 modulo2^32; xor>>16,mul0x85EBCA6B,xor>>13,mul0xC2B2AE35,xor>>16. Coordinate hash%32; positive iff highbit set; collisions sum.
candidate.loss: Mean binary cross-entropy using the unchanged general runtime/novelty learning_reward.
candidate.eligible_positions: Existing chosen/reward_choices mapped to sorted distinct exact tape indices; for M positions select N=min(12,M) using positions[i*M//N].
candidate.optimizer: One SGD update if N>0; learning_rate=0.05/sqrt(1+steps/4000); globalL2 clip1 over all537 gradients; then steps+=1.
candidate.hidden_state_lifecycle: Reset before BOS for each generated program; each selected unit advances once; hypothetical candidates do not mutate the prefix state.
candidate.exact_law_source: Frozen standalone candidate source, independently reviewed and numerically checked before launch.

sequence_off: Same final sequence-trained memory and all acquired recurrent parameters; only sequence_memory.enabled becomes false. This disables the sequence path during frozen learn=False evaluation; no parameter or acquisition update occurs in any evaluation arm.
denominator: Every raw generated attempt; failures and source replays remain in the original seed slot.
productive_definition: Existing core field: runtime success and novelty relative to corpus; experience_replay can remain productive. Accepted/status counts and unique productive behavior hashes are reported separately.
freeplay: Separate frozen task=None evaluation of each final arm and task-trained replica; no extra training.

development_gate.margin_units: absolute number of productive attempts under equal fixed raw budget
development_gate.source_replay_per_task_pooled: at most first separately for table and numbers

confirmation: Only if development gate passes; fixed fresh seeds and same gate, all three table replicas must improve; no sweep.
gallery_selection: Development table replica 0, first evaluation seed where sequence is productive and first is not; if absent first productive sequence seed; if absent no success sample.
mechanism_audit: Frozen actual learned recurrence versus readout disabled, initial transitions restored with learned readout retained, and a fixed permutation of recurrent input sequence; matched-prefix probabilities and complete source hashes. Recurrent input intervention never edits emitted source.
